_note:
Site-wide sponsors — the brand tier sold on /sponsor. A DIFFERENT PRODUCT from services/placements.py, which sells one dealer a slot on one /bhav crop page and resolves collisions by geographic specificity. This file holds the whole-site sponsor: one brand, one category, every section. Keep them apart — merging them would let a ₹199 district listing and a ₹25,000 category partnership compete for the same render, and the cheaper one would sometimes win.

RENDERS ONLY WHEN active:true AND name, url and until are all non-empty AND until is in the future. A half-filled row can never reach a farmer, and an expired one disappears on its own rather than waiting for someone to remember — the same guard lead_offers.json uses, for the same reason.

TRUST RULES, none of which bend:
  • Every sponsor unit is labelled 'प्रायोजक · Sponsored' in the markup, visibly, above the card. Not in a tooltip, not in Terms.
  • Every outbound link is rel='nofollow sponsored'. We sell attention, never PageRank; selling a dofollow link is a Google penalty on ~15,000 pages to earn one month's server bill.
  • 'category' is what exclusivity was sold on. Two active sponsors may never share one. Enforced by tests/test_sponsors.py, not by memory.
  • We make NO claim about the sponsor's product — not effectiveness, not price, not availability. 'line' is the brand's own one-line description and is rendered as theirs. A dosage or yield claim in it is our legal exposure, not theirs.
  • Ranking, mandi prices, article advice and search results are NEVER influenced by who paid. A sponsor buys a labelled slot and nothing else. This is the one promise that makes the site worth sponsoring at all.

_schema_example.active: true only once payment has actually landed — not on a verbal yes
_schema_example.name: Brand name as it should appear
_schema_example.category: the exclusivity sold: fertilizer | seed | pesticide | tractor | irrigation | insurance | finance | feed
_schema_example.line: one line, the brand's own words, no dosage/yield/price claim
_schema_example.until: YYYY-MM-DD it is paid through; the row stops rendering the day after
_schema_example.sections: [] = every section, or a list of path prefixes like ['/bhav','/articles']
_schema_example.states: [] = all states, or a list of states like ['madhya_pradesh', 'uttar_pradesh']
_schema_example.crops: [] = all crops, or a list of crop slugs like ['soybean', 'wheat']
